up: List the IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against human Beta-secretase 1 (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL4822). For each matching activity, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and the PubMed ID or DOI (preferring PubMed ID if available), along with the assay description and the activity comment. Only include rows where the compound has a canonical SMILES and the associated document has a PubMed ID or DOI.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.activity_comment
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4822'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
